NOTE
**Still not ready — the PR's own Test 2 shows the issue's second case still fails**

New: The author says it's updated, but no new code was pushed. Missing: Test 2 says a collapsed message that is then revealed still shows hidden or needs collapsing again, so the issue's second case isn't fixed. The screenshots are also still a long set of unclear images rather than precise before/after pairs.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and leave it unassigned; laurynmm, who gave the feedback, can follow up when a new push arrives.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! There are no new commits since the earlier feedback, and your Test 2 notes say the expand/collapse case from the issue still doesn't work, so please fix that and push. Then redo the screenshots following the [precise before/after guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots), and we'll take another look.
```
